items.title: unlabeled-command-columns
items.claim: In Image #6, move recipes contain two symbol circles separated by a plus sign, but the recipe columns themselves are not labeled Stance and Technique.
items.reason: Players must connect each recipe back to the separate legend to identify which stick supplies each input.
items.suggest: Add a Stance + Technique column header directly above the move recipes, aligned with their respective symbols.

items.title: duplicate-stick-headings
items.claim: In Image #3, Stance and Technique each appear twice: above the directional instructions and below their respective sticks.
items.reason: Repeated headings add visual clutter without teaching an additional action.
items.suggest: Keep the labels beneath the sticks and remove the duplicate headings from the instruction panel, retaining its directional explanations.

items.title: result-pose-disconnect
items.claim: Image #18 announces Asmongold wins while Asmongold is shown in a kick pose and HasanAbi remains upright in guard.
items.reason: The character poses do not reinforce the outcome announced by the text.
items.suggest: Use distinct victory and defeat poses for the result display rather than retaining combat poses.

items.title: text-size-unverified
items.claim: The point-value labels in Image #6 are visible, but this raster does not establish whether their rendered font sizes meet the required 18 CSS-pixel minimum.
items.reason: Players need readable scoring information when choosing techniques, and an unsupported size estimate could prompt the wrong fix.
items.suggest: Measure computed font sizes and effective scaling in the running panel at 390×844; enlarge and reflow any labels below 18 CSS pixels rather than shrinking surrounding content.

items.title: boot-progress-unverified
items.claim: Image #1 shows Downloading the game above a progress track with no distinguishable filled segment, but one still cannot establish whether progress advances.
items.reason: Players need truthful loading feedback; treating an initial capture as a stall could lead to misleading artificial progress.
items.suggest: Leave the loader unchanged until a throttled-network recording and timestamped completed-work counters establish its behavior; fix only a demonstrated disagreement between those counters and the displayed fill.
